title: Vendor Performance Note: Late-Arrival Share of Deposit-Program Ridgeline Special Order Services Delivery Charges
content:
A vendor that delivers an item late to the store lowers the home delivery charge on a delivered Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent.

**Clause.** The late-arrival share depends on the calendar days by which the ready date is later than the promised ready date: more than twice the program's vendor delay threshold gives a late-arrival share of 0.5; more than the threshold and not more than twice it gives 0.75; otherwise the late-arrival share is 1.

The delivery charge billed is multiplied by the late-arrival share before its single rounding to the nearest cent; the share itself is never rounded.

## Bands for the deposit programs

| Program | Threshold (days) | Share 0.5 | Share 0.75 | Share 1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors | 21 | more than 42 days late | 22 to 42 days late | 21 days late or less |
| Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry | 21 | more than 42 days late | 22 to 42 days late | 21 days late or less |
| Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops | 14 | more than 28 days late | 15 to 28 days late | 14 days late or less |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical Windows and Exterior Doors order, promised ready date 13 April, charge of 99.00 before the share)

| Ready date | Days late | Share | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 May | 21 | 1 | 99.00 |
| 5 May | 22 | 0.75 | 74.25 |
| 25 May | 42 | 0.75 | 74.25 |
| 26 May | 43 | 0.5 | 49.50 |

The ready date is the date the item became ready at the store; the promised ready date never moves.
